faq.title: Block Out! Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything new players ask before they get hooked.

questions.question: What is Block Out! and how do you play?
questions.answer: Block Out! is a color-sort puzzle by Grand Games. You slide colored blocks across a board so each block exits through the gate of its matching color. The challenge is the order: pick the wrong block first and the rest get trapped behind it.

questions.question: Where can I download Block Out!?
questions.answer: Block Out! is free on both the App Store and Google Play. Search 'Block Out Color Sort Puzzle' or use the download buttons on this site.

questions.question: Is Block Out! free to play?
questions.answer: Yes — the game is free to download. There are optional in-app purchases for hints and an ad-free mode, but the full level set is playable without paying.

questions.question: How is this site different from the in-game hint?
questions.answer: In-game hints typically reveal one move at a time and cost coins. This site shows the full sequence in a short video and adds written tips so you understand why the order works — useful when the next level has a similar shape.

questions.question: How many levels are there?
questions.answer: Grand Games keeps adding levels with each update. We track the latest publicly released set on the Levels page; if a number is missing, it means we haven't recorded a video for it yet.

questions.question: Can I play Block Out! offline?
questions.answer: Yes. The core puzzle works offline. A connection is only required for ads, daily challenges, and leaderboards.

questions.question: How do I get better at Block Out!?
questions.answer: Look at the gates before you touch a block. The path of every piece is constrained by the others around it, so the easiest move is rarely the right first move. Plan three moves ahead, then commit.

questions.question: Is this an official Grand Games site?
questions.answer: No. This is an independent fan-made walkthrough site. We are not affiliated with Grand Games, and the game's name and assets belong to the developer.

howToUse.title: How to play Block Out!
howToUse.subtitle: Three rules. Then it's all about the order.

steps.title: Slide blocks toward matching gates
steps.description: Each colored block needs to leave through the gate of its own color. Drag the block in any direction; it slides until it hits an obstacle or the wall.

steps.title: Plan the order before you move
steps.description: The wrong block first will block the others. Look at the gates and figure out which piece can leave last — work backward from there.

steps.title: Use undo, then commit
steps.description: Undo is unlimited and free. Use it to test a sequence, but once you know the order, play it cleanly — the satisfaction is in the solve, not the trial-and-error.

description.main: Block Out! is a slide-and-sort puzzle game where you guide colored blocks to gates of their matching color. The early levels teach the slide mechanic; the later ones make the order of moves the entire challenge.
description.gameplay: Simple controls, deep planning — short levels you can play in a queue, harder levels worth a 10-minute solve.

list.title: One-finger controls
list.description: Drag a block in any direction and it slides until it hits a wall or another block. That's the whole control scheme.

list.title: Order-of-operations puzzles
list.description: The same board has many possible move sequences but only one or two correct openings. Trial-and-error works on early levels; planning works on every level.

list.title: Quick sessions
list.description: Most levels solve in under 60 seconds once you see the pattern, so it's easy to play one level between meetings or on a commute.

list.title: Skill, not stars
list.description: No stamina meter, no daily life cap on the main level set — replay any level to chase a faster clear.

howToPlay.title: How to play
steps: Drag a colored block toward its matching gate.
Each block slides until it hits something — plan around walls and obstacles.
Clear all blocks to finish the level.

tips.title: Beginner tips
list: Look at the gates first. The block whose gate is most boxed-in usually has to leave first.
If a block has only one possible exit path, leave that path open until you're ready to use it.
Use undo to test ideas — there's no penalty.

download.closing: Free to download, fast to learn, deep enough to keep coming back to.

gameInfo.title: About the game
gameInfo.text: Block Out! is a color-sort puzzle by Grand Games for iOS and Android. You slide colored blocks across a board so each block exits through the gate of its matching color. Levels start as gentle introductions and ramp into multi-step planning puzzles where the order of moves is everything.

introduction.text: blockout.cc is a static site. We don't ask you to log in, we don't run a database, and we don't store anything you type. The only data collected is the standard request log your browser sends to any web server, plus the analytics and ad systems noted below.

Anonymous page-view counts via privacy-respecting analytics, when enabled
Standard ad-network data via Google AdSense if/when ads are loaded — see Google's privacy policy for details

nonCollected.title: What we don't collect
items: Account data — there is no login
Any text you enter into the site (the level-jump input runs entirely in your browser)
Personally identifying information beyond what your browser sends to any web server

dataUsage.title: How data is used
